transcript: Good morning judges. In our architecture, we resolved downstream database contention by introducing Redis as an asynchronous write-behind cache and partitioning hot tenant tables. This dropped our p99 transaction latency from 4.2 seconds down to 85 milliseconds while preserving 99.99% availability during peak flash sales.

strengths: Exceptional eye contact (91% gaze locked on camera lens)
Optimal executive speaking cadence at 142 WPM (within target 130–150 range)
Tangible reduction in filler words compared to previous sessions
Precise technical storytelling using quantitative latency benchmarks
improvements: Conclude with a dedicated 10-second summary on ROI and operational cost savings

recommended_drills.title: 30s STAR Conclusion Drill
recommended_drills.instructions: Deliver a 30-second punchline summarizing the business and customer impact of your architecture decision.
